translations.web: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,
translations.bsb: But when the Gentiles and Jews, together with their rulers, set out to mistreat and stone them,
translations.kjv: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,
